answer: Because the cipher register is reconciled against the forge funding graph each close, hiding costs more than declaring, and the pulse audit publishes the forfeited amount. An operator must disclose every key it controls, and an undisclosed key found later voids that operator's rewards for 13 epochs. Disclosure is inexpensive for an honest agent and self-defeating for a farm, which pays 13 epochs of dead time for every key it tried to hide. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
